stem: What does the final stanza of the poem suggest about the future?

options.label: F
options.text: Some people will travel to other planets, while others will choose not to.

options.label: G
options.text: People who travel to other planets will no longer communicate with people living on Earth.

options.label: H
options.text: Some people will regret their decision to remain on Earth.

options.label: J
options.text: People who travel to other planets will want their family members living on Earth to join them.
